name: atNorth SWE01 Stockholm metro site
notes: Kista/Stockholm colocation and high-density compute site; atNorth says SWE01 opened in March 2022 and is powered by renewable energy with heat recovery.

name: atNorth SWE02 Stockholm metro site
notes: New heat-reuse enabled Kista-area metro data center near SWE01; announced as 30 MW and scheduled to go live in Q4 2027.

name: Conapto Stockholm 4 South expansion
notes: Conapto announced an additional 8 MW from Ellevio, scaling Stockholm 4 South from 20 MW to 28 MW, with capacity ready from 2026-01-01.

name: evroc flagship Stockholm Arlanda data center
notes: evroc selected Arlandastad next to Stockholm Arlanda Airport for a flagship hyperscale cloud/AI data center, planning EUR 600 million investment and 16,000 GPUs at full capacity.

name: Equinix Stockholm data centers
notes: Equinix markets Stockholm colocation facilities and states it has three data centers in Sweden with roughly 160,000 sq ft of colocation space.

name: EdgeConneX Skelleftea data center campus
notes: EdgeConneX announced plans to acquire land in Skelleftea from Lyten/former Northvolt assets; DCD reports the site could support up to 1 GW, subject to approvals and full development details.

name: NDC Finnfors / Skelleftea Kraft green data center park
notes: NDC said it would build one of Sweden's largest 100% renewable-powered data center parks in Finnfors outside Skelleftea; later status not confirmed in current sources.

name: Meta Lulea Data Centre
notes: Meta's Lulea data center is part of its global infrastructure; contractor DPR describes it as Meta's first hyperscale data center outside the United States.

name: Hydro66 / Northern Data Boden data center
notes: Hydro66 brought a hydro-powered Boden facility online with 3.2 MW initial power and expansion potential; later market listings identify the former Hydro66 site under Northern Data/Ardent.

name: KnC Miner Boden data center
notes: Data Center Knowledge reported KnC Miner operating a 30 MW data center in Boden taking advantage of low-cost hydropower; current operating status should be treated as historical unless refreshed by newer primary source.

name: Vantage ARN1 Tierp / Mehedeby campus
notes: Market listing and Stockholm Business Region post identify Vantage's first Sweden campus in Tierp/Mehedeby, Uppsala County, planned for 2028; capacity not disclosed in public source found.

name: AWS Europe (Stockholm) Region - Eskilstuna and Katrineholm data centers
notes: Business Sweden says AWS opened data centers in Eskilstuna, Vasteras, and Katrineholm in 2018; Amazon later said it was building new data centers in Eskilstuna, Katrineholm, and Vasteras with main buildings due mid-2025.

name: Brookfield Strangnas AI Data Center
notes: Brookfield announced a SEK 95 billion AI infrastructure investment centered on a new AI center in Strangnas; DCD reports 750 MW over 10-15 years.

name: EdgeMode Marviken AI data center
notes: EdgeMode and Vertical Data announced a strategic collaboration for a 20 MW AI-optimized data center at Marviken with 95 MW renewable PPA, immersion cooling, and district-heating integration.

name: National Supercomputer Centre at Linkoping University
notes: University HPC/data services center at Campus Valla, Linkoping; includes national supercomputing resources such as Berzelius and Tetralith upgrades.

name: Junet Birka data center
notes: Inflect lists one Jönköping-area data center, Junet Birka, at Birkagatan 41, Huskvarna; Data Center Map also reports one Jönköping facility.

name: Invid Jonkoping data center
notes: Datacenterplatform lists Invid Jönköping at Batterigatan 18, Jönköping; limited public technical detail found.

name: Ansluten Vaxjo data center
notes: Ansluten has an official Växjö datacenter page; Data Center Map lists the facility at Honnorsgatan 10 with 150 sqm data-center area within a 250 sqm site.

name: Kalmar NDC Datacenter
notes: Datacenterplatform lists Kalmar NDC Datacenter at Sodra Vagen 58, Kalmar, with company website pointing to Kalmar NDC backup/datacenter services.

name: BRS Networks / DLC NEZ Gotland data center
notes: DCD reported DLC expanding into a Tier III Gotland facility codenamed NEZ built by BRS Networks and set to open in 2016; current operating status not confirmed from accessible public sources.
